outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Navigating to 10. Change Log (?tab=change_log) crashed the entire React tree into the red Crash-Only Error Boundary: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length') at ConfigAndChangeLogTabs.tsx:266:45.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: scripts/direct_sot_harvester.py (lines 2667-2725) persisted direct-SoT audit entries into .local_backup/local_changelog.json using legacy keys (oldValue, field, rowKey, status) instead of the TypeScript ChangeLogEntry interface (previousValue, fieldChanged, lineageId, primaryId, syncStatus). When ConfigAndChangeLogTabs.tsx evaluated entry.previousValue.length, undefined.length threw an uncaught TypeError.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated scripts/direct_sot_harvester.py to emit canonical ChangeLogEntry keys alongside legacy aliases, migrated all 25 entries in .local_backup/local_changelog.json, added normalizeChangeLogEntryShape() in src/App.tsx, and added defensive String(entry.previousValue ?? entry.oldValue ?? '') normalization in ConfigAndChangeLogTabs.tsx.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: ?tab=change_log renders all 25 audit rows with 0 pageErrors, 0 consoleErrors, and firstRowTopPx = 344px (<= 380px).

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Full URL navigations in Puppeteer/Playwright with waitUntil: 'networkidle2' timed out or leaked open HTTP connections across tab switches.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: src/App.tsx opened a persistent Server-Sent Events (EventSource('/api/live-stream')) stream on mount and only closed it inside React's unmount cleanup, without closing sseSource on window beforeunload or pagehide.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Registered window beforeunload and pagehide listeners in src/App.tsx to close sseSource immediately prior to page navigation, and updated scratch/e2e_forensic_audit_runner.mjs to preserve screenshots 01..21.png.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: All 18 tabs navigate cleanly in Headless Chrome with 0 leaked SSE connections and 0 navigation timeouts.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: scratch/e2e_forensic_audit_runner.mjs failed Sensor 2, Sensor 6, and all 12 tabWalkthroughResults because it queried legacy numbered sidebar labels ('0. Certified SoT'..'11. EAP Features Tracker').
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: The left sidebar was expanded from 12 numbered tabs into 18 domain-grouped tabs across 4 sections without stable data-testid="sidebar-tab-<id>" attributes.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Added deterministic data-testid="sidebar-tab-<id>" attributes to all 18 sidebar navigation buttons in src/App.tsx and updated scratch/e2e_forensic_audit_runner.mjs + scratch/screenshots_e2e_forensic/e2e_forensic_report.json to audit all 18 tabs.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: 18/18 tabs pass walkthrough assertions in e2e_forensic_report.json with 0 console/page errors.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Navigating across Customer Asks & Comms, Product Feature Requests, Product Bugs, Process Gaps, and Automated FR & CR Studio emitted React console.error warnings: Encountered two children with the same key, GMAIL-FMfcgzQhWxXd.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: LiveMultiSourceSotExplorer.tsx rendered raw feed items from live_multi_source_sot_feed.json where multiple discovered Gmail threads shared the same message prefix ID (GMAIL-FMfcgzQhWxXd).
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated sanitizeFeedItemList() in src/components/LiveMultiSourceSotExplorer.tsx to track seenIds and assign deterministic deduplicated keys (${baseId}-dup-${idx}).
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: 0 console.error messages across all 18 tabs (verified in Headless Chrome).

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Primary data tables on 4 core tabs were pushed below the Rule 25D 380px Above-the-Fold ceiling: certified_sot (496px), automated_fr_cr_studio (539px), config_lookups (468px), and change_log (430px).
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Multi-row promotional banners, secondary <LiveMultiSourceSotExplorer compact />, and diagnostic callout cards were stacked above the primary data tables instead of below them.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Relocated <LiveMultiSourceSotExplorer compact /> below the primary table on certified_sot (496px -> 357px), relocated filed-cr-572808626-next-steps-banner and LiveMultiSourceSotExplorer below the main table on automated_fr_cr_studio (539px -> 354px), compacted the header banner on config_lookups (468px -> 330px), and relocated cb-eng-notifications-banner below the main table on change_log (430px -> 344px).
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: 16/16 operational table tabs render their first <tbody><tr> at Y <= 357px (strictly below the 380px Rule 25D budget).

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Left navigation sidebar <aside> used dark navy bg-[#0b132b], GeminiSpecLineageTab used a dark #0b132b status strip, AutomatedFeatureRequestCrStudioTab used a dark bg-slate-900 banner, and 11 modal headers used bg-slate-900.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: Legacy dark-theme classes (#0b132b, bg-slate-900, bg-slate-950) remained across the navigation rail, subheaders, and modal headers in violation of Rule 54 Universal Executive Light Theme.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Converted the left sidebar <aside> and collapsed flyout popovers in src/App.tsx to Executive Light Theme (bg-white, text-slate-900, border-slate-200, active pill bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200), converted GeminiSpecLineageTab and AutomatedFeatureRequestCrStudioTab bars to bg-white/bg-slate-100, and converted all 11 modal headers to Light Theme.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: In Certified SoT (Tab 0) Column 1, the L2 Manager taxonomy pill ('2. Agent Designer & Multi-Agent Workflows') wrapped vertically 1 character per line down the right edge of the cell, Care Team 'Edit' wrapped into 'Edi / t', and Column 8 date/author wrapped mid-token.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: In CertifiedForensicLineageTab.tsx:L5726, a non-wrapping flex row contained two shrink-0 siblings ('● OPEN' and '📅 Created...'), starving the 3rd child (rec.taxonomyL2_Manager with min-w-0 truncate) to ~8px width, which combined with src/index.css:L159's white-space: normal !important; word-break: break-word !important; forced 1-char-per-line vertical text.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Added flex-wrap to the Column 1 metadata row, replaced min-w-0 truncate with leading-tight break-words max-w-full on the L2 Manager badge, and added shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap to the Care Team Edit button and Column 8 date/author pills.
outageRcaAndRemediation.verifiedAfter: 0 vertical 1-character-per-line text stacks, 0 tableCellOverflows, and 0 nakedTruncateSpans across all 18 tabs.
